exposure: Timing of rapid HIV test results
Hospitals with median time to breastfeeding onset at birth greater than 60 minutes (late breastfeeding onset)
trimester at which prenatal care started
timing of rapid HIV test results
Hospitals with median time to breastfeeding onset at birth up to 60 minutes (early breastfeeding onset)
outcome: Time from birth to first feeding
cohort: 932 pregnant women who underwent rapid HIV testing admitted to Baby-Friendly Hospitals for delivery
finding: Cesarean section and rapid HIV test results received after birth were associated with delayed onset of breastfeeding in Baby-Friendly Hospitals.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a later onset of breastfeeding.
